## 1. What the parent is told when a child ends

**The message** is built by `childEndedLine` in `packages/agent-runner/src/parent.ts:29-37` (described in `parent.LOGIC.md:20, 36-42`):

- First sentence, always: `The run ${end.id}, started for this run, ended ${end.status}${end.detail ? `: ${end.detail}` : ''}.`
- Then, each on its own line and only when present:
  - `It is waiting on a question: <title>` (whitespace collapsed to single spaces)
  - `Its work is on the branch <branch>.`
  - `Its pull request: <url>`
- Then, when the last turn's text is not blank: an empty line, `Its last words:`, and that text trimmed.

**Per end status** (call sites `packages/agent-runner/src/run.ts:480-499`, `:166`, and `packages/agent-runner/src/sweep.ts:55-58, 81, 95`):

| Status | First sentence | Other lines |
|---|---|---|
| `done` | `…ended done.` | Branch only if the reclaim did not delete it (`run.ts:499`); an empty branch goes with the checkout. PR if one was read back. Last words. |
| `failed` (driver threw) | `…ended failed: <error message>.` | Branch, PR, last words under the same rules as `done`. |
| `failed` (no checkout) | `…ended failed: could not create a checkout: <error>.` | Nothing else (`run.ts:162-166`). |
| `failed` (sweep, process died mid-work) | `…ended failed: its process died before the run ended.` | Branch if kept, PR; no last words, no question (`sweep.ts:57, 81, 101`). |
| `failed` (sweep, never started) | `…ended failed: its process died before the run started: <last 5 stderr lines>.` | No branch (`sweep.ts:95, 108`). |
| `stopped` (signal) | `…ended stopped: stopped by a signal to its process.` (`STOPPED_DETAIL`, `run.ts:53`) | Branch, PR, last words as for `done`. |
| `stopped` (sweep, no checkout, no stderr) | `…ended stopped: its process is gone and left no checkout.` | No branch (`sweep.ts:113`). |
| `waiting` | `…ended waiting.` | Question line, branch (always), PR if any, last words (`run.ts:490-492`). |

Test examples of the exact strings are in `packages/agent-runner/src/parent.test.ts:44-55`.

**Delivery** is `tellParent`, `parent.ts:64-79`:

- **Parent working** means its live card says `running`, the card's mark names this host, and the pid is alive (`parent.ts:51-55`). The message is appended to `.the-framework/inbox.jsonl` in the parent's checkout as `{ kind: 'message', text }` (`:67-70`). The parent's session takes it when its current turn ends and sends the text verbatim as the next turn (`promptOf`, `packages/agent-driver/core/src/inbox.ts:63-65, 82-84`).
- **Parent ended** (anything else, including another machine's card or no checkout): `deps.resume(parent, { text })` is called (`:74-75`). For the real project that is `resumeDetached` → `spawnResume` → a detached `agent-runner run --resume <parent> <line>` (`packages/agent-runner/src/runner.ts:105-107, 190-192`). It waits on the parent's run lock, so two children ending together resume the parent one after the other (`parent.LOGIC.md:62`).
- **Parent ends meanwhile**: after the inbox write the parent is checked again; if it is no longer working, the whole inbox is taken back and each line resumes the parent in order (`:71-75`).
- **No `resume` given**: an ended parent is not told (`:74`).
- **Never throws**: failures log `[agent-runner] the parent run <id> could not be told: <error>` (`:77`).
- The scheduler's sweep also passes `resume: resumeDetached(repo)` (`packages/agent-scheduler/src/scheduler.ts`, the `sweep:` line near `:39`).

**When a child ends `waiting`:**

- **Question text in the message: title only**, from `parseQuestion(lastText)?.title` (`run.ts:438`). Options and `recommended` are not given as separate lines. The raw `await-choices` block does appear inside "Its last words", because `lastWords = turn.text` (`run.ts:424`).

- **Answer wording**: `continuationPrompt` in `packages/agent-driver/core/src/question.ts:118-120`:

## 2. How a run decides it ended `waiting`

- **Decision** (`run.ts:432-440`): if not stopped by a signal and the turn loop ended `done`, then `question = parseQuestion(lastText)?.title`; `if (question !== undefined) status = 'waiting'`. `lastText` is the last turn after the driver drained the inbox, so "asked and nothing waited in the inbox".
- **"Asked a question"** means the last turn's text contains a usable fenced block tagged `await-choices` (`QUESTION_TAG`, `packages/agent-driver/core/src/question.ts:20`):
  - `parseQuestion` (`:65-71`) takes the last block that parses, skipping malformed ones.
  - The block needs an `options` array with at least one labelled option (`:84-99`).
  - A blank title becomes `'Which option?'` (`:105`).
  - Shape: `title`, `options[{id,label,detail?,default?,stop?}]`, `recommended?`, `multi?`, `file?` (`:23-48`).
- **The agent-facing instructions** are in `packages/skill-question/SKILL.md:8-18` (line 16: "one quoted in your last reply counts as asking"). That package has no code, only the skill file.
- **Where the question is stored:**
  - Diary: a `{ kind: 'question', title, options, recommended?, multi?, file?, at }` line. It is emitted by `finishTurn` (`packages/agent-driver/core/src/inbox.ts:78-79`) and written by `diaryLine` (`packages/agent-driver/core/src/session-log.ts:235-236`).
  - Card: only `status: 'waiting'`. `RunCard` has no question field (`packages/skill-logs/src/run.ts:13-34`).
  - `question` is not one of the four diary kinds `skill-logs` knows (`:44-52`), so `agentLines` drops it; it passes through as a writer's line.
  - Readers: `run.ts:260` (resume) and `packages/framework/src/store/run-record.ts:92` (dashboard).

## 4. Stopping a run and its children

There is no code that stops children when a parent is stopped.

- The only places `parent` appears in runner source are the mark, the CLI flag, and `tellParent` call sites in `run.ts`, `sweep.ts`, `runner.ts`, `records.ts`, `cli.ts`. In `packages/agent-scheduler/src` it appears only in a test-repo comment.
- A stop is SIGINT/SIGTERM to the run's own process. It aborts that run's driver session (`run.ts:373-376`), which signals the agent CLI's process group (`killTree(-pid)`, `packages/agent-driver/core/src/cli-session.ts:133, 144-151`). `run.LOGIC.md:105`: "Nothing else stops a run."

- The dashboard's Stop is a single `process.kill(meta.pid, 'SIGINT')` for that one run (`packages/framework/src/dashboard-rpc/control.ts:45-57`).
- `orchestration stop <id>` signals one subagent's pid, and only the caller's own subagent (`subagents.ts:148-157`).
- A stopped parent drops whatever is in its inbox (`run.ts:457`).
- A child that ends after its parent was stopped finds the parent not working and resumes it through `run --resume <parent> <line>` (`parent.ts:74-75`). `resumeOnce` refuses only a missing record, a record still `running`, or one without the tool's mark (`run.ts:249-254`), so a `stopped` parent is resumed.

I want to cap changes-needed rounds to one—if a second review still isn't a pass, it counts as a fail, consistent with the ticket's "retried once, one level up" rule.
